items.title: Physical AI is more than robots, says the Nvidia veteran now investing in it
items.summary: Amulya Vishwanath, who spent seven years leading product marketing for NVIDIA’s robotics platforms, says robotics is currently in its “Lego era,” with the basic building blocks like actuators, robotic hands, software, and safety standards still being rebuilt. items.title: Elorian’s first AI model wants to reason with images, not just about them
items.summary: According to Elorian's evaluations, Glimpse outperforms even GPT-6 Astra on scientific chart reasoning and short-form video captioning, with competitive results on other visual reasoning tasks.
items.titleKo: 엘로리안의 첫 번째 AI 모델은 이미지에 대한 것이 아니라 이미지에 대한 추론을 원합니다.

items.title: Tressfecta wants to make hair braiding a less arduous task for hairstylists
items.summary: Tressfecta builds products for textured hair. Its first project is a tool called Plait Pilot that helps braiders with the initial process of separating hair from packs before braiding begins.
items.titleKo: Tressfecta는 헤어 스타일리스트에게 헤어 브레이딩을 덜 힘든 작업으로 만들고 싶습니다.
items.summaryKo: Tressfecta는 질감 있는 모발을 위한 제품을 만듭니다. 첫 번째 프로젝트는 브레이더가 브레이딩을 시작하기 전에 팩에서 머리카락을 분리하는 초기 과정을 돕는 Plait Pilot이라는 도구입니다.

items.title: Veritas expands its anti-counterfeit chip to jewelry, trophies, and fragrance bottles
items.summary: Counterfeiters are getting better at replicating brands' marks and passing off dupes, known as "superfakes," as genuine items. A startup called Veritas wants to tackle the problem with its own chip that verifies goods.

items.summaryKo: 위조자는 브랜드의 마크를 복제하고 "슈퍼 페이크" 로 알려진 속임수를 정품으로 전달하는 데 점점 더 능숙해지고 있습니다. Veritas라는 스타트업은 상품을 검증하는 자체 칩으로 문제를 해결하고자 합니다.

items.title: When it came to Cal AI’s viral success, a small army of influencers paid off
items.summary: The company generated over $30 million in revenue in two years and was acquired by MyFitnessPal for an undisclosed amount of money in March.
